articleTitle: Realization of Eel Fish Farm with Artificial Intelligence Part 3: 5G based Mobile Remote Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This paper is about the development of mobile app for integrated control and real time monitoring of smart fish farm based on IoT. It controls an important role of water processing in the recirculating smart fish farm. The proposed smart fish farm consists of Water Tank1, Water Tank2, Balancing Tank and RAS. In this aquaculture the water flow process is regulated by the PID controller along with water level ultrasonic sensors, water temperature sensors, DO and pH sensors. This designed aquaculture system operates on manual mode, automatic mode and remote mode by using mobile phone. To verify the performance of the designed system, the field tests were conducted in Future Creative Technology Research Institute of Busan University of Foreign Studies. It showed satisfactory performance of smart fish farm by experimental results.

articleTitle: Realization of Eel Fish Farm with Artificial Intelligence Part2: IoT based Flow Control Using MQTT
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This study is about developing mobile application with message queue telemetry transport(MQTT) communication to monitor and control conditions of temperature of water, oxygen level, pH level and DO of water with mobile or automatically. This water circulates in smart fish farm and makes fish living in healthy environment. The smart fish farm installation and design were explained our previous study. The sensors were arranged in all the locations where the data monitored and then collect the data and stored in server as big data. This data were monitored to regulate the conditions of water by using Internet of Things (IoT). Controlling can be done through the mobile. The present system was successfully installed onsite and results were satisfied.

articleTitle: Development of Haptic Virtual Welding Torch Control System Using 3D printing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Welding is one of the basic tasks required in various industries as well as manufacturing. The purpose of this study is to develop a haptic torch to create an environment similar to actual welding in order to use a welding simulator as a training tool. In order to develop a torch with a haptic technology, we created a torch using a 3D printer and reduced the error by increasing the position accuracy using the Polhemus simulation tool. Using a welding simulator with a haptic torch capable of controlling the intensity of a vibration motor, we found that it was very similar to actual welding.

articleTitle: Study on Fast Needle Puncture to Reduce Pain
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This study focused on evaluating different COFs (coefficient of friction) between needles and skin generated by different diameters, surface treatments, needle loads, and puncturing speeds of syringe needles. The goal of this study is to design a COF measurement device and to find a way to reduce the skin pain caused by needles in order to improve the quality of life of those who need frequent blood collections and injections. The result of synchronized measurement of high speed camera and load cell indicates that the distance, instantaneous speed, average speed, friction force and COF are proportional to diameter of syringe needles. The aforementioned experimental result also indicates the maximum COF is at diameter of 1.2 mm, followed by 0.8 mm and 0.5 mm. That is, a needle with a larger diameter will produce greater friction and COF during passage through human skin, resulting in greater pain. The summary of experimental results indicates that the higher needle puncturing speed, the smoother needle surface (for example, the coated surface), the less needle load, and the smaller needle diameter will result in smaller COF such that it can reduce the pain caused by friction during needle puncturing. The key points of the experimental result are summarized as below: 1.With needle diameter of 1.2 mm and bare needle load of 100 g, the μs (the maximum static coefficient of friction) is reduced by 60% (0.89: 0.36) and the μk (the dynamic friction) is reduced by 61% (0.80: 0.31) when the needle puncturing speed is increased from 0.01 m/s to 1.35 m/s. Note also that μs is always greater than μk, 2.With needle diameter of 1.2mm under puncturing speed 0.01m/s, the μs and μk reduced by 9% (0.65: 0.59) and 5% (0.57: 0.54) respectively, when the bare needle load is decreased from 200g to 100g. 3.With needle load of 100g under speed 0.01m/s, μ s is reduced by 20% (0.59: 0.47) and μk is reduced by 24% (0.54: 0.41) when the needle diameter is decreased from 1.2 mm to 0.5 mm. 4.With the needle diameter of 1.2mm under speed 0.0 1m/s and load 100g, the comparison between bare needle and coated needle indicates that μs is reduced by 32% (0.65: 0.44) and μk is reduced by 30% (0.57: 0.40).

articleTitle: Research study on applying SLAM-Based Augmented Reality technology for gamification history guided tour
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This study employed simultaneous-localization-and-mapping-based augmented reality technology in a guided tour for a historic site. Virtual objects integrated real environment to promote users' senses of immersion, and a gamification mechanism was applied to enhance their experience and learning outcomes. The historic site of this study was Nishi Honganji Temple in Taiwan. The literature and historical materials related to the temple were analyzed, and its historical appearance was reconstructed using a novel technology. The effectiveness of simultaneous-localization-and-mapping-based augmented reality in historical and cultural representation and learning enhancement was explored. The results indicated that use of the technology was effective for enhancing users' learning, and most of the participants reported having a positive experience.

articleTitle: Detecting Leakage Water of Shield Tunnel Segments Based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: As a common shield tunnel problem, segment water leakage has a great impact on durability and applicability of tunnels. Therefore, the detection of leakage water is an important task for maintenance of shield tunnel. However, the traditional detection method is based on conventional image processing technology which has low accuracy, poor robustness, being difficult to meet the needs of actual engineering. In this paper, we proposed a leakage detection model based on deep learning Mask R-CNN through transfer learning with small-scale dataset. Our study shows that the proposed detection model is superior to the traditional image recognition algorithm in terms of accuracy, precision and recall.

articleTitle: Advanced Supply Chain Development Avoiding Interruption Risk on Big Data Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: With the development of economic globalization, the supply chain of enterprises presents a trend of expanding operation and faces various unpredictable risks, leading to supply chain disruption crisis. This study takes the supply chain of a company as an example. Through field investigation and interview and focus group interview method, FMEA analysis and VIKOR method are applied to construct the house of quality on big data approach. The research results show that the enterprise can further improve and develop the resilience of supply chain and achieve the effect of sustainable operation through the ranking of resilient indexes.

articleTitle: Color Detection Algorithm for Fish Robot Position and Swimming Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This paper is on the development of color detection algorithm for fish robot swimming in the aquarium to control position of fish and avoid inference of other fishes in their paths. This proposed system obtains position of each fish by detecting the color of the fish to control the position and swimming. Radio Frequency module is used in the proposed detection of fish movement. The experiment result shows the position identification of fish improves swimming of the fish in their way without any interruption of other fishes.

articleTitle: GIS-Based Synthetic Measurement of Spatial Distribution and Hotspot Analysis on Aquarium in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The industry of ornamental fish has been developed for more than 50 years in Taiwan. In 1986, through the artificial cultivation of the blood parrot (Cichlasoma citrinellum × Cichlasoma synspilum), the industry of aquarium fish reached to the peak in Taiwan. After the African Cichlids was introduced from three major freshwater lakes in Africa, it caused a sensation on the market. Then fluorescent fish and crystal shrimps were introduced, so far showing vigorous development of the aquarium market in Taiwan. The results of the spatial analysis show the highest density of the aquarium in urban area. The cluster spatial pattern was identified by global autocorrelation analysis, including Average Nearest Neighbor and Global Moran's I. Besides, after the stock market crash in 1980, the aquarium industry experienced a serious setback, but it also indirectly led to the trend of industrial management transformation from traditional aquarium to pet shops combining two types of cats and dogs pet aquarium.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality in Building Interior Decoration Engineering Practice
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In recent years, the public pays more and more attention to the quality of house to flourish the interior design industry. In accordance with the relevant laws and regulations, those engaging in interior decoration and construction businesses should give priority to obtain the Certificate of Interior Decoration & Repairs Management of a Building, which is also one of the objectives of vocational college education. However, due to the restrictions to space and equipment on campus as well as safety considerations, it is difficult to provide the opportunity for students experiencing on-site constructions. However, virtual reality can provide such assistance. For this reason, this study aims to develop the related VR auxiliary materials for interior decoration practice based on the requirement of technical and vocational education for students in technology universities. Meanwhile, the participants are also trained to learn related technical skills and research development capabilities during the implementation of the project, so as to truly implement the spirit of technical and vocational education.

articleTitle: Research on Marine battery health management based on SOC estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The state of charge (SOC) estimation of the marine lithium battery pack is verified by the Vmin unscented Kalman filter. The simulation verifies that the Vmin unscented Kalman filter method has higher accuracy in estimating the battery pack SOC. At the same time, researching on health management strategy of lithium battery packs in combination with ship operating conditions and analyzing the state of charge, single voltage, current and photovoltaic power of marine lithium battery pack, the battery status are divided into three states: healthy, sub-healthy and unhealthy. The actual ship operation shows that the battery pack health management can ensure the lithium battery pack works within the safe range.

articleTitle: Promoting the efficiency of learning Computer network course with the use of Cisco network devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In Taiwan, `Computer Networks' is a basic course which most students in information-related departments should study. This course includes introduction to networks and OSI network communication model. The goal of this course is to teach the students understand the network communication opinion and protocols. However, most students in the universities of Science and Technology in Taiwan cannot really know how and what network communication model operates. In this paper, the reason of this learning phenomenon is found mainly that the students hardly image the operation of network communication protocol just via the oral teaching or traditional teaching methods. Hence, we investigate the performance efficiency of learning network computer with a network simulation tool designed by Cisco, called Packet Tracer. Through this tool, the students can deeply understand the packet routing among the network devices and also can see the packet structure composed by packet header and payloads via fetching network traffic. Finally, we also give an easy questionnaire for students and obtain the result that the students prefer the teaching network computer with this useful simulation tool and think it can promote the learning efficiency of this course.

articleTitle: Study on the feasibility of improving the indoor air quality from the perspective of circular economy by activation of biological calcium
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In order to cope with excessive use of energy since the industrial revolution, environment has been seriously polluted and the large amount of waste has been produced. The circular economy has become the driving force for sustainable development of the earth, with the aim of maximizing resource efficiency and minimizing environmental impacts with the hope of achieving a vision of zero waste and friendly environment. As consumption of eggs increases, most of the discarded shells produced each year are treated as waste, which pollute environment. Researches on the environmental restoration of eggshells as an absorbent have brought a lot of results, but it is only used for absorbing industrial heavy metals, dye and for energy catalysis. The edible biological calcium of eggshell and its multi-layer microporous structure provide a good absorbing property. Therefore, based on literature, this study will observe the microporous structure through electron microscopy (SEM), and by (XRD) to analyze the crystal structure, pH value and redox potential (ORP), for finding the most economical and absorption-efficient calcination time and temperature. After eggshells are calcined for two hours at 900 degree Celsius, its detection value has become constant (or nearly), and its structure has also changed from the original shale-flake to a multi-layer microporous structure showing physical absorption capacity for indoor air pollutants, and its chemical absorption conditions are also effective. Preliminary experiments also show degradation results for indoor air pollution. This research can be further used for a study of absorption performance to improve indoor air quality, and as a reference for application and development as a green building material.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of the Lithium Polymer Battery Module Part 2: Investigating Thermal Performance of PCM in Cold Temperature
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This study is about investigating lithium polymer pouch battery warm up condition with phase change materials during cold temperature of -21°C. Extreme temperature conditions are not suitable for the battery, because due to uneven chemical reactions at low temperatures, resulting in unexpected starting problems of vehicle sometimes. To avoid such issues, we proposed thermal management system with phase change materials(PCMs). Experiments were conducted with RT15, RT31, EG5 and EG26 and also without phase change materials around the battery and expose battery to cold weather conditions for long time known as cold soaking. Compare the battery thermal conditions with and without PCMs. With PCMs, the battery can remain warm upto 8 hours. The warm rate with PCMs improved by 70% are observed when compared with no PCMs. In previous study part1, thermal management for the battery exposed to high temperatures were studied.

Author Keywords: battery performance and phase change materials

articleTitle: Intelligent Elderly-Care in the Era of Internet and Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In the 21st century, all the advanced countries in the world are facing serious problems of aging and great trouble caused by increasing demands for long-term care. However, with the development of computer technology as well as popularization of the internet and smart phone, human beings have stepped into the era of digitalization, when the internet and big data develop fast and are applied extensively in almost all of people's activities. Even, it has overturned the old provision patterns for the aged completely and brought new chance of “intelligent elderly-care” for the future visions of Chinese elderly-care policies.

articleTitle: Disaster Rescue Dog IOT Device and Chest Strap Design
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Rescuers and search dogs must enter the disaster area within the golden rescue time. Design meets the mission needs to increase efficiency. The IOT device and package performs better communication and increases productivity. Other sensors record the status of the dog (heartbeat, temperature and GPS positioning). When the temperature is high, the system reminds the dog to prevent heat stroke. Rescuers click the recall button, and the remote device sends a signal to direct the dog to return.

articleTitle: Development of Impact Wrench Torque Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This paper is about the development of pneumatic impact wrench torque for the accurate measurement system. Accurate measurement is a problem for high speed rotating equipment. To overcome this problem in this system, we developed the digital measuring impact pneumatic wrench torque system for accurate measuring of torque with signal processing system so that accurate measurement is possible. Experimental results show the satisfied results and applied in industries and running successfully.

Author Keywords: torque measurement system and digital measurement system

articleTitle: Study of Vibration Influence Mechanism with Load for Marine Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In this paper, influences of different loads on the electromagnetic vibration of Marine generators during stable operation are studied. The electromagnetic vibration response model is established by theoretical analysis of the variation rule of the internal synthetic magnetic field of the generator under the load of inductive or resistance. Maxwell tensor method is applied to deduce electromagnetic waves under different synthetic magnetic fields, and modal superposition method is used to calculate the vibration response of generator stator. Finally, it is verified by ANSYS Electronics simulation and experiment, and the experimental results are consistent with the theoretical analysis results.

articleTitle: The Development of Hybrid Power Management Unit for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This paper examines the creation of power management unit for the UAV hybrid power system, which allows increasing the UAV flight time and distancing significantly. This development is suitable for UAV hybrid systems with gasoline internal combustion engine. The main feature of this development is support and control of energy generation for the UAV. The proposed concept includes controls of the engine cooling, ignition, engine rate and throttle, generation current, engine start and cut-off. The system is suitable for copter, plane and VTOL UAVs. Due to the dense layout of particular vehicles, it is necessary to resolve the issues of electromagnetic compatibility, based on protection and decoupling of various elements among themselves. The controlling device for the internal combustion engine of vehicle carries out a complete decoupling of control and signal circuits, and protection of power for integrated circuits. The constructive decisions described in this paper include the installation of optically decoupled devices, protective diodes and resistances for bypassing the high voltage surges. It is explained how these features ensure the stability of the engine and its primary characteristics of engine rate support and generation current control. Processes of hybrid system prototype modelling, technical decisions and reliability issues have been described. The main outcome of this paper is a tested hybrid system prototype. This work can be used to develop the engine control units with high reliability and diverse set of functions.

articleTitle: Optimal Decision of Photovoltaic Generation Injection Point in Unbalanced Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In this paper, the photovoltaic generation was considered as the only one renewable power source to supply system load of a chemical factory directly. An improved genetic algorithm was applied to determine the optimal location and capacity of newly constructed PV generation systems by considering system loss minimization and improving voltage unbalance through simulation with solar power injected.

articleTitle: The Research of VR and AR Technology on Cultural Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The aim of this study is to emulate real scene that help user get immersive experience. In the paper, the tasks of the VR panorama fused construction include image acquisition, image registration, image smoothing and image fusion. Specifically, the image information can be acquired according to the projection model. To render 3D realistic scene, the key steps are that using linear fusion algorithm, the gradually fading out algorithm and the image registration algorithm based on feature point recognition. Based on the positioning of promoting Maritime Silk Route Culture, we choose 18 unique scenic spots in Quanzhou known as an oriental seaport and the start of Marine Silk Road, and make an overall design that connects the separate parts to the virtual scene roaming system. By integrating the virtuality and reality, the civilization of maritime silk route is better integrated into modern technology.

articleTitle: Research on Systematic Application Strategy of Green and Healthy Interior Design Materials in Lingnan Area
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In response to the basic national policy of “green development” and “healthy China”, this paper takes the architecture and interior materials of Lingnan traditional residential buildings as the object of study, and summarizes and refines the green wisdom of adapting local materials. The paper modernizes and updates the wisdom and technology of the traditional green materials, based on the current green and healthy building evaluation standard system and the summary of material application in the modern green interior design practice. Proceeding with eight aspects of spatial form, air quality, green lighting, furnishings, low-carbon energy saving, green construction, intelligent system and virtual presentation, the paper proposes the suitable strategy for systematic application of material in order to provide a theoretical basis of constructing the green and healthy interior environment that adapts the climate of Lingnan.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation and modal analysis of 4190 Marine diesel engine block
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This paper takes 4190ZLC marine diesel engine as the research object, uses PRO/E and HYPERMESH to 4190 diesel engine. The finite element model for subsequent calculation is obtained by considering the actual constraint conditions of the diesel engines and verified by modal test calculation. The results show that the vibration natural frequencies of finite element simulation modal and measurement are basically identical. The error is less than 5%. It verifies correctness of the model, providing an important theoretical basis for the improvement of diesel engine block structure. In addition, finite element method is used to study the structure mode of the marine diesel engine, the results can be used to guide the structural optimization and vibration isolation improvement design of diesel engine, preventing the resonance damage of diesel engines and improving the reliability of the diesel engines.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of In-situ Full Scale Test of Pile-head Core Pullout Resistance of Improved PHC Pile
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: PHC pile is the most widely used pile in mainland China and Taiwan, and the joint between pile head and pile cap is a problem that cannot be solved effectively in foundation engineering. Pullout resistance force on the pile-head core of improved PHC pile is tested in full scale, and the test result is compared with theoretical calculation and conventional estimation of PHC pile. The test pile of PHC 600 B 100-10 is a 600 mm diameter, 10 m long pile with pile head of 2 m in length. There are 6 layers in 2 by 2 horizontal D19 rebars placed within inner portion of the pile head. Test is followed with ASTM-D3689M. The result shows that the pullout loading goes up to 175 tons, and the theoretical value of the pullout resistance force calculated from the pile-head core is 371 tons, which is 7.5 times and 6.2 times higher of the pullout resistance force of the 2 m long pile-head core compared to the conventional PHC pile proposed by two literature studies respectively. The result also shows that the improved PHC pile can be more effectively connected with the pile cap.

articleTitle: Feasibility for Rapid Assessment of Mangroves by the Application of Satellite Imagery Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Mangrove forests are an important wetland ecosystem that provides numerous valuable resources to the marine environment and people. Unfortunately, mangrove forests are already one of threatened environments globally mainly by human disturbance, urban development and tourism activities. The change of wetland mangroves has become an important ecological indicator of the impact on coastal areas. Understanding the factors controlling wetland structure is vital to conservation and management. The issue of mangrove change is valued by ecologists, but it is difficult to survey the area through traditional methods. In this study, multi-temporal FORMOSAT-2 and FORMOSAT-5 satellite images with a resolution of 4 metres were used to detect mangrove cover and changes. Changes of the mangroves over the study period showed that the mangroves have a slight growth trend from 2016 to 2019, and the changes are located at the edge of channel and mangrove forest. Using NDVI, the areas of mangroves were estimated at 10.5-ha., 10.6-ha. and 10.62-ha. in 2016, 2017 and 2019, respectively. The overall Kappa coefficients are between 0.86-0.94. Finally, the technique of satellite remote sensor can be a quick assessment of mangroves, which provides meaningful information for wetland management.

articleTitle: Discrete to Continuous Model Conversion of multiple time-delayed distributed power grid with A Singular Continuous-Time System Matrix
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Transmission delay time can be neglected on traditional large-scale electricity system. However it is a serious issue in distributed power grid (DPG) system. In DPG system, electricity is propagated through highly related transmission line network and the impact of transmission delay will be amplified. This highly interconnected attribute will not only cause the power system less efficient but also make whole system unstable. Aimed at solving the above difficulty, we generate a matrix sign function. This method is good for multi-state, input delay DPG system. Using the proposed matrix sign function, a lagging and time discrete system with multiple lagging is turned up to an uninterrupted time system with multiple time lagging. We also provide a discrete time model to demonstrate how compelling of our new method.

articleTitle: Realization of Fully Automatic Harvest Unit for Water laver in the Korea Sea
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This study is about the realization of water laver harvesting system that operates on fully automatic. This development is to avoid the problems such as heavy winds, sudden high waves and transient weather conditions in harvesting of water laver in seas. Standing on the ship and holding the seaweed nets can reulsts in injure workers. Due to the above problems, in this project, we proposed automatic harvesting collect method which is operated without human. We design and develop an automated ship that is divided in to three parts; supporting roller, drum screener, and lifting mechanism. These are operated with hydro pneumatic equipment and controlled with micro controller.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Application of Ecological Compensation to Highway Construction
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This study has modified the evaluation framework and its assessment score table that were used earlier to apply ecological compensation to study the environmental impact of transportation infrastructure construction. The previous evaluation framework which has four major issues with a total of 16 factors was established by the Fuzzy Delphi method (FDM) and the weighted value for each factor in its ecological compensation assessment table were determined by using the Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchical process (FAHP). However, the evaluation framework was formulated to work with all types of transportation infrastructure. After having studied quite a few highway construction projects, it was found that some of the factors may not be suitable to study the environmental impact on highway construction projects. This study has proposed a new framework for highway construction with four issues and 12 factors. The new assessment score table is still obtained by using FAHP. However, the three compensation mechanisms, “Avoidance”, “Mitigation” and “Compensation” and the criteria to determine the proper ecological compensation mechanism are still used. Finally, the ecological compensation of a highway construction project has been studied by using the proposed framework to show that it can be used in future highway infrastructure construction ecological compensation study.

articleTitle: A Case Study for Selecting a Protection Method in Underground Excavation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Urban transportation infrastructure construction has been going under the ground or towards the sky. The metropolitan rapid transit (MRT) underground system is one of such examples. Since the MRT construction is mainly shield tunneling underground excavation, it is important to select proper construction protection method to prevent the impact of the MRT construction on the existing structures especially when the geological stratum at the earth surface is very soft and has a lot of old and rot driftwood. The purpose of this study is to select the proper protection method to be used along the MRT line to ensure the safety of tunneling excavation and existing structures. This study first investigates the five construction protection methods to be used and determines the criteria and sub-criteria to be used in the initial assessment framework for the protection of the existing structures and tunneling excavation, and then it establishes the final assessment framework by using the Delphi method. Furthermore, the Analytic Hierarchical Process (AHP) questionnaires are used to determine the relative or absolute weighted values of these criteria of each level in the hierarchical structure of assessment framework by building contrast matrices to facilitate the establishment of a scoring table. Finally, the selection process is presented by using a study case in one of the MRT routes.

articleTitle: Working Mechanism Research on Complex Condition of Shield Machine Cutters Structure Optimization Design for a Tunnel Segment Assembly System of Shield Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The shield machine is a large-scale construction machine with intelligent and highly complex system to achieve the goal of excavation by a hybrid control system of machine with electricity and liquid. Due to the complex and varied working conditions of the excavation, it is necessary to consider the specific excavation parameters and use a variety of tool combinations in order to improve efficiency. Under this condition, this paper comprehensively considers the effects of various condition parameters on the tool. The working mechanism of the shield machine tool is studied by the computer technology. The influence of the environmental change of the working condition on the working mechanism of the tool is discussed in depth. The influence factors of service life of various materials are analyzed, which provides a theoretical basis for the selection of cutters. It provides a comprehensive evaluation mathematical model for the rational construction and application of the cutters, and an important theoretical basis on the development and construction of the intelligent engineering machinery.

articleTitle: Temperature Management of the Internal Surface of Power-Plants Combustion Chamber using Semitransparent Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The paper examines control and management by temperature of the internal surface of combustion chamber walls for high performance diesel and turbine engines due to the application of semitransparent thermal barrier materials, coatings (determined by variable porosity) causing significant subsurface radiant overheating. The authors proposed a model for reducing NOx concentration due to a decrease of the surface temperature caused by a shift of radiant absorption zone to the depth of semitransparent thermal insulation.

articleTitle: Radiant Overheating of Semitransparent Glacier Cover
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Optical models of semitransparent glacier cover (with scattering and absorbing snow and ice layers) depending on their physical structure are presented in this study. At absorption indices (~1 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) and the scattering ones (~10-1000 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) for transparent ice and inhomogeneous snow, their albedo changed accordingly from ~30% to ~98%. For the first time, theoretical estimates of the subsurface temperature distributions with positive (negative) gradient in active upper layer of the glacier at combine heat exchange were offered for developed optical models of snow and ice covers. The formation of internal radiant overheating was discussed.

articleTitle: Structure optimization design for a tunnel segment assembly system of shield machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The segment assembly machine is a very important part of the shield machine, which is to lining the excavated surface. The segment assembly machine must meet the following two conditions: the segment assembly machine must be lined a full circle of segments accurately and have six degrees of freedom to operate. And the piece assembly must reach high precision, requiring high assembly precision of each component, high rigidity and no creeping when running at low speed. In this research, the force model of the walking beam and roller set of the segment assembly device of shield machine are calculated and analyzed in detail by computer modeling technology and computer simulation technology. The three-dimensional computer-optimized model of the mechanical structure is obtained by a numerical method of the general continuous field problem and the approximate solution of the finite element method. The stress field distribution is obtained, while the stress field distribution map of the roller axle is obtained by the finite element force analysis software combined with the limit conditions in the actual working conditions. It also provides a more advanced design for optimized design of the mechanical structure of the walking beam and roller set and provides a reliable design method for the mechanical module of the segment assembly machine with that theoretical basis of strength design, stiffness design and stability design.

articleTitle: Optimization Design Research on Hydraulic System for a Tunnel Segment Assembly Device of Shield Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The segment assembly system of shield machine is a multi-degree-of-freedom system by hybrid control using electricity and hydraulics. Its control method has great influence on the stability of the whole machine, the stability of the surface and the work efficiency of its system. In order to reduce surface settlement, the assembly machine must be efficient, stable and reliable in its work. The assembly system has six degrees of freedom, and control system of degree of freedom relies on a hydraulic system. Whether it is a translational circuit, a circumferential circuit, a radial circuit, a fine-tuning circuit, a locking circuit and so forth, each circuit achieves a corresponding function by controlling an actuator in the hydraulic system. The system is a hydraulic working system, which uses PLC to control hydraulic cylinders to realize the handling of material segments. The multi-degree of freedom system can realize various movement postures of the segments and position and lock the segments. This paper analyzed the mechanism of its multi-degree-of-freedom series-parallel system. The influencing factors of the weak link of the parallel multi-degree-of-freedom system are analyzed and modified. The research of the fine-tuning system was also carried out, and the control precision and stability of the system were improved through analyzing the influencing factors and optimizing the design of the fine-tuning system. It provides reasonable optimization methods and solutions for the hydraulic system design of various shield machines through the transformation and redesign of the hydraulic system.

articleTitle: Microbial Community Structure Diversity in Different Sludge Used as Reducing Barrier for Tailings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: For a long time, how to prevent and control pollution caused by various heavy metals in tailings has been a technical problem. The existing research results show that it is feasible to prevent the harm of Acidic Mine Drainage (AMD) by using the microbial action of Compacted Sludge Reducing Barrier. In this study, microbial high-throughput analysis was used to study the relationship between the diversity of microbial community structure of dewatered sludge and heavy metals contents, in 4 municipal sewage wastewater treatment plants with different sources and different wastewater treatment processes. The results indicated that each of the sewage treatment plant had its own unique microbial community structure, and its correlation of environmental factors was also different. This study provided a theoretical basis for the microbial mechanism and test of Compacted Sludge Reducing Barrier.

articleTitle: Properly Learned Convolution Neural Networks and Local Optimization for Optimal Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: Recently, costs of power generation of power plants have risen greatly since energy has been lacked of and environmental protection greatly emphasized. The costs could not be transferred to the clients. Therefore, it is very important to apply optimal power flow to analysis of power market economy. In the paper, local optimization algorithm and convolution neural network are applied to determine solution of optimal power flow containing with both discrete and control variables based on Equivalent Current-Injection method. Based on the load flow model of the current injection method, the programmed variables are divided into continuous control variables and discrete ones. The continuous variables are generator-bus voltage magnitudes on the bus bar and the active power outputs in the ordinary optimized power flow method. The discrete variables are the shunt capacitor devices, transformer-tap settings and phase shifters. Next, convolution neural network properly learned to fast compute planning results. They are used as initial conditions for local optimization method. The proposed Artificial Intelligent method is utilized to verify for modify IEEE 30 bus power system and compared with those from other algorithms for faster computation efficiency and higher quality solution.

articleTitle: A Lighting Control Device for Lighting Optimum Energy LED with Pattern Changes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: In this paper, the efficient lighting control module for lighting optimum energy LED with pattern changes is proposed, which is to reduce power consumption and increase LED's life-cycle and heat efficiency of LED lighting module. The new proposed lighting control module for lighting LED devices is divided into 4 levels of lighting based on surrounding illuminance by measuring illuminance and applying automatic pattern lighting algorithm. Other than that, level check will be used to light up for a set of time by applying intersection lighting algorithm of magic square pattern forming a full symmetry. When it detects movement during the lighting time, it maintains full luminous flux by lighting all LEDs. The experimental analysis result shows heating value and power consumption reduced to maximum 30 percent and lifetime of LED improved to maximum 60 percent in comparison with previous lighting system. Therefore, applying the new system to LED streetlight can achieve stability and high energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Visualization Simulation Research of Urban Wind Environment in Hot and Humid Climate
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This research uses the “Typical meteorological year 3” actually observed by the Central Weather Bureau to analyze hourly meteorological data of TMY3 typical meteorological years for 8760 hours in Taipei, Hualien, Hsinchu, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung, inputting meteorological data for up to 15 years (1998-2012). While using the parametric design program “Rhino Grasshopper” and its open source plug-in “Ladybug” to shorten the simulation analysis calculation time and workflow to get intuitive data visualization graphic of wind environment. In the future, under extreme climate and warming climate environment, it is extremely important to conduct scientific simulation and evaluation of the performance under wind environment. We can not only be providing a reference for the initial assessment of architectural design, in order to create a sustainable, energy-saving, healthy and happy living area, but also can be providing a new idea between “future climate and wind environment” and “architectural design”. This research predicts that if future architectural education uses visual analysis of big data and meteorological data to make early architectural design choices, it will have the following three advantages: 1.Providing valuable data for visual analysis. 2.Improving the thinking of localization of architectural education: Taiwan's optimize design solutions and optimization selection in the hot and humid climate environment. 3.Predicting building energy-saving operations and energy development based on knowledge-based design.

articleTitle: Overall Design for a Tunnel Segment Assembly System of Shield Machine Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: The segment assembly machine, an important part of the shield machine, must be ensured for the timely lining of the excavated tunnel to secure the normal operation and to continue to travel and excavate of the shield machine. The quality of the tunnel assembly will directly affect the penetration and surface settlement of the groundwater, and the speed of the assembly will directly determine that of the shield machine. Therefore, the high quality, speed, accuracy of assembly is the key to the development of shield machine technology. The segment assembly machine is used to lining the surface of the tunnel to ensure the excavated tunnel surface to be consolidated and to be excavated forward. This paper analyzes the function in detail firstly to check out working principle and overall composition of segment assembly translation system of the shield machine. A detail layout and structural optimization design analysis were carried out combined with the partial design and hydraulic control system. Through the coordination study of the mechanical mechanism and the hydraulic control system, the overall performance of the segment assembly translation system is comprehensively reviewed and the segment assembly translation system can be further developed.

articleTitle: Realization of Eel Fish Farm with Artificial Intelligence Part 1: Lego Type Structure Aquarium
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Architecture, Construction, Environment and Hydraulics (ICACEH)
abstract: This paper is about the design and structural analysis of proposed vertical recycling aquarium system(VRAS) with space optimization. Many aquariums occupies more space and utilizes more water for the aquaculture. To avoid this problem, we proposed VRAS that will occupy less space because of Lego type and due to this structure, recirculating is also easy. Sludge removal from the tank is also easy with the conical structure of the culturing tank. The design was done in the ANSYS and also simulation was carried out in the FLUENT software. The simulation results were very much satisfying the experimental results.
